In a fission power plant, the reaction rate is maintained at a steady state by adjusting the position of the control rods. Which statement describes how these rods perform this function?

  1. By reflecting neutrons back toward the center of the fuel assembly
  2. By acting as a heat sink to dissipate excess energy from the fuel
  3. By capturing neutrons to ensure the reaction remains at a critical level
  4. By providing a structural framework to support the uranium pellets
